candidates.source_title: क्या आपने कभी सोचा है कि पुराने भारी-भरकम CRT TV में तस्वीर कैसे बनती थी?#technologygyan #facts
candidates.source_description:
How did traditional CRT televisions create moving pictures without modern LCD or LED screens? 📺

This 3D engineering cutaway takes you inside an old CRT TV and explains the electron gun, vacuum tube, magnetic deflection coils, phosphor screen, and RGB color technology.

Discover how a stream of electrons was controlled and scanned across the screen thousands of times to create the images we watched.

A simple-looking old television was actually an incredible piece of electronic engineering!

⸻
